worktree: Pre-existing unrelated changes excluded; new run executed against baseline, using the scripts listed below.

inputs.native: 2026-11-27_wilor_native_hands, archived parameters for each side and each eye; one source per complete body

conditions: wrist suffix: rotate wrist to stereo index/pinky MCP with regularizer to native orientation
B_wrist suffix: use archived B wrist rotation and retain native finger rotations
validation: 33 in-frame observed tips in identical order, over 2 stereo pairs and 4 hands. No manual or 3D ground truth. Native and SMPL-X shape coefficients are independent. Checked hand segment rotations, position preservation and OBJ readback. Renders used the OBJ vertices after parsing.
